chars.HAMID: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, neatly trimmed short black beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey joggers
chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman around 26, soft round face, wearing a light pink hijab and a long lavender home kaftan
chars.SISTER: a Moroccan woman around 28 who lives in France, long loose wavy dark-brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a fitted red turtleneck sweater and black jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Apartment front door in Fes at night, Moroccan apartment in Fes, zellige tiles, low Moroccan sofas with patterned cushions, warm lamp light. Seen from the hallway behind HAMID's shoulder: SISTER stands in the open doorway holding a big rolling suitcase, giving HAMID a wide playful smile and a little wave; HAMID holds the door, surprised. Head-to-waist framing, SISTER's face clearly visible, at most 2 characters, subjects centred.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan bedroom at night, warm bedside lamp. WIFE sits on the bed excitedly showing HAMID a message on her phone, smiling; HAMID listens, eyebrows raised. Both faces visible, centred, head-to-waist.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan bedroom at night, warm bedside lamp. HAMID shrugs kindly and nods with an open hand gesture as if saying 'she can stay with us', WIFE hugs his arm happily. Both faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon in Fes, evening, Moroccan apartment in Fes, zellige tiles, low Moroccan sofas with patterned cushions, warm lamp light. A welcome dinner: a round low table with tagine, bread and mint tea; WIFE hugs SISTER warmly, HAMID smiles politely pouring tea. Faces visible, subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment kitchen in Fes, morning light. SISTER in a red sweater makes herself at home, leaning on the counter with a coffee cup and laughing; her clothes hang on a chair, her suitcase open in the corridor behind; HAMID in the doorway looks at the mess, mildly puzzled. Faces visible, centred.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon in Fes at night, blue TV glow, Moroccan apartment in Fes, zellige tiles, low Moroccan sofas with patterned cushions, warm lamp light. Medium close-up of HAMID on the sofa, frowning slightly and glancing sideways with suspicion, as if something is not normal. Face in the upper-middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon in Fes at night, blue TV glow, Moroccan apartment in Fes, zellige tiles, low Moroccan sofas with patterned cushions, warm lamp light. Seen from the doorway: SISTER slides along the sofa until she sits very close to HAMID, almost touching, smiling at him; HAMID leans away stiffly with wide eyes. Head-to-waist, both faces visible, centred.
